paragraphs: Photos or Videos?, posted by Lily. Teacher Kim put a sheet of paper on the library wall. It says, "Should our blog have more photos or more videos?" I am the blog editor, so I read every opinion. Many members put a mark next to photos or videos. But we also need to know why. Here are three opinions.

Mia writes: I choose photos. Photography is my favorite hobby. A good photo tells a story. People can look at it for a long time. I click the camera many times to get one good photo. Last month, I took many photos of the library. I think that photos are better for a blog, because they are quick to read. Videos are fun, but they are too long. Nobody wants to wait on a small screen.

Leo writes: I do not agree with Mia. A short video shows what a photo cannot show. A video can have sound, and a photo cannot. A video can show Pip when he fetches a ball. Everybody loves Pip, so people will click on it. Tom loves riding, so he can ride his bike in the park. Pip can run after him. I can make the cartoon music for it. I think that a video of Pip will have the most clicks on our blog.

May writes: I agree with Leo about the video of Pip. Pip does not speak, so he is not nervous in front of a camera. I am nervous when a camera looks at me. I also agree with Mia, because photos are quiet and kind. Maybe we can have photos in every post. And we can have one video each month. It is fair for everybody.

Teacher Kim read the opinions on Thursday. "That is a good idea," she said. Tom is riding his bike in the park on Saturday. Pip will run next to him. Leo will hold the camera, and Mia will check the photos. Pip does not know about the plan yet. He just wants his ball. I will upload the video on Sunday. Do you want photos or videos on our blog?
text.summary: Lily asks the Explorers if the blog needs more photos or more videos. Mia, Leo, and May write their opinions, agree with each other, and plan a first video with Pip.
